text:
marta: FYI prefill rate controller in ap-south1 is throttling heavy requests — queue depth for gpu-pool-3 jumped to ~18k and latency SLOs are degrading :eyes:
oncall-bot: alert: queue_depth > 15k for gpu-pool-3 (ap-south1). Incident channel: #eng-infra-incidents
sam: copy — linking dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/queues/ap-south1?orgId=1 :link:
marta: top offenders by model: mosaic-xl (55%), mosaic-8b (22%), misc rerank jobs (13%). Prefill rate at 1.2req/s per pod, bursts causing KV cache churn. cpu pressure on admission controller pods at ~85%
devin: quick triage — sounds like prefill + admission smoothing failing. Short-term mitigations: 1) reduce prefill_rate for mosaic-xl in ap-south1 to 0.3, 2) enable strict admission for low-priority routes, 3) route mosaic-xl -> mosaic-4b fallback for non-critical tiers.
raj: what's the risk of OOMs if we keep current behavior? cost to spin up extra nodes?
marta: we've seen a few GPU OOM kills on gpu-1 nodes earlier, dmesg shows nv/oom on pod p-runner-12. snippet:
```
[ 1234.567890] Out of memory: Kill process 4521 (python) total-vm:12000000kB, anon-rss:8000000kB
[ 1234.568000] Killed process 4521 (python) total-vm:12000000kB
```
we can expect more OOMs if queue keeps growing and KV caches expand
sam: short patch I can apply now — patch rate-controller config: `kubectl -n infra patch configmap rate-controller --type merge -p '{"data":{"prefill_rate.mosaic-xl.ap-south1":"0.3"}}'` then `kubectl rollout restart deployment/rate-controller`
devin: also recommend enabling queue TTL to drop stale requests: set queue.duration_limit=30s for affected pool; that prevents infinite backlog buildup and buys time
elaine: I can run the patch and monitor. Will also toggle model fallback routing for non-prod customers.
oncall-bot: action assigned: elaine -> run prefill throttle + set queue TTL. Incident ticket #INC-2026-331 created.
sam: after patch, watch tail of queue and pod restarts. I'll keep an eye on eviction_count metric and admission_retries.
raj: if backlog persists beyond 40m, we should provision 4 spare p4 nodes in ap-south1 and enable burst capacity (we can roll cost to emergency buffer). I'll open a quick request to infra-provisioning.
marta: plan summary: immediate (0-10m) apply prefill throttle + queue TTL; short-term (10-60m) enable model fallbacks + scale admission controller to 3 replicas; mid-term (60-240m) provision burst nodes if queue not reducing. logging owner: elaine.
devin: capture actions in runbook and set postmortem owner. Also flag possible tuning: KV cache eviction policy and smaller kv-window for mosaic-xl during high churn
elaine: doing the patch now, will post logs and timestamps here when done :thumbsup:
sam: thanks — I'll take dashboard watch. ping me if you need emergency routing change.
marta: nice work team. we'll do a short retro after stabilization and look at per-model prefill profiles so this doesn't repeat :white_check_mark:
